verdicts.reason: A: the headline is big and readable, but the windmill icon is shrunk to a tiny speck squeezed into a jumbled strip of shapes on the left, and those shapes are crushed miniatures of the original. The text breaks into four lines ('ENERGY FOR / FUTURE / SUMMIT / MARCH 18') and the date has no visual separation from the title. The two diagonal lines are stranded on the right, so the layout is lopsided and fails as a fit to the format. B: it is just the original shrunk into a centred box with large empty margins on both sides. The headline is tiny and barely readable, and the background shapes are cut off at the box edges. It keeps fidelity but fails readability and does not suit the banner shape. A is less bad because its message is readable.
